RimCourt.Court.PetitionDef.label: a grievance against the seat itself
RimCourt.Court.PetitionDef.description: A colonist the lord has ruled against too often comes to ask the lord for redress against the lord.
RimCourt.Court.PetitionDef.caseText:
{PETITIONER_labelShort} comes forward alone. There is nobody to stand opposite {PETITIONER_objective}: the complaint is against {LORD}, and {LORD} is on the seat.
{COUNT} times this court has ruled against {PETITIONER_labelShort} or sent {PETITIONER_objective} off without an answer. {PETITIONER_pronoun} does not say any one of them was wrong. {PETITIONER_pronoun} says all of them together are a habit, and that a lord who is never wrong is a lord nobody can bring anything to.
The hall has gone quiet. How does the lord rule?

li.label: Grant that the court has wronged {PETITIONER_labelShort}
li.pastLabel: the court admitted its own fault

li.label: Rule that the court has always ruled correctly
Have {PETITIONER_labelShort} flogged for speaking so to the seat
li.pastLabel: flogged for insolence to the seat

li.label: Let the hall wait, and say nothing
li.pastLabel: no answer given to the accusation
